about.title: About us
about.subtitle: Welcome to Synergy QMP
about.body: The Synergy QMP team offers regulatory compliance support and radiation safety training, integral to the nuclear medicine community. Our team collaboratively delivers over 20 years of clinical nuclear medicine expertise, radiopharmacy, regulatory compliance, radiation safety and emergency management training, quality assurance and educational experience to provide high quality training and governance support to our customers.
about.imageAlt: The Synergy QMP course book, certified by CAMRT / ACTRM

objectives.title: Learning objectives
objectives.subtitle: In accordance with the requirements of the Transportation of Dangerous Goods Act and Regulations.

items.title: Transport
items.body: Become familiar with the regulations for transporting radioactive materials by ground.

items.title: Classification
items.body: Understand the classification standards for dangerous goods in Canada.

items.title: Packaging
items.body: Choose the proper packaging for the transportation of Class 7 packages.

items.title: Marking
items.body: Assign safety marks to radioactive packages and prepare proper paperwork.

items.title: Shipping
items.body: Apply the standard procedures for shipping, handling and receiving radioactive packages.

items.title: Emergency
items.body: React appropriately in case of emergency or possible contamination.
